about: Joins the road tracer cannot see, found by checking each dead end on the map by eye: the road continues to the place under a label or a culture square. Each joins the road node at 'end' (map px) to the place 'place'.

join.why: the dashed road curls up into Noota Nara's square
the road runs on into Gul-Tej's square
the dashed road from the homestead continues down to Seafalls
the dashes run under the 10.100 ruler label to the ruin
the road passes the logging camp; its spur to the dot is hidden under the culture square
